name: spring-boot-tools
description: Spring Boot toolkit: focused skills and reviewers, coordinated build hooks and seven diagnostic MCP tools sharing project discovery and build execution.

app_port.title: App port
app_port.description: Port where the Spring Boot app runs locally

stop_verification.title: Stop verification
stop_verification.description: Build check when Claude stops: verify (Maven verify / Gradle check), compile, or off. Skipped when project inputs are unchanged since the session started.

stop_timeout_seconds.title: Stop verification timeout
stop_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds for the Stop build check (30 to 600)
